name: @w6w-apps/simplybook
description: Manage SimplyBook.me bookings, clients, services, providers and locations.

w6w.longDescription:
SimplyBook.me is an online booking system for service businesses — salons, clinics, consultants, fitness studios — that turns a public booking page into a filled calendar. This app brings the Admin REST API (v2) into a workflow: create, look up, cancel, approve and decline bookings; check open slots before offering a time; and read back the services, providers (staff/units), locations and clients behind a booking.

A common pattern is triggering a workflow off an external event — a form submission, a CRM stage change, a support request — and creating the booking directly, or checking availability before recommending a time elsewhere. Booking writes go through the same `AdminBookingBuildEntity` shape the SimplyBook.me admin panel itself uses, so a booking made here shows up exactly like one made by staff.

This app covers the booking lifecycle and the read-only catalog data around it; it does not touch invoicing, payments, memberships, packages or promotions, which stay specific to each company's billing setup.
